pixel_thresholds.percentages: 100 * matching_pixels / all RGB pixels, rounded to four decimals

thresholds.pass_label: long_window_retreat_consistency_pass if KSCI >= 9 and span_gate and scene_pair_gate pass

pixel_thresholds.black_pixel: R <= 5 and G <= 5 and B <= 5 after RGB conversion
pixel_thresholds.bright_pixel: R >= 200 and G >= 200 and B >= 200 after RGB conversion
pixel_thresholds.percentage_denominator: all RGB pixels in the preview image

criteria.description: Returns the requested compact JSON fields with numeric values in the expected units and the final label.
criteria.name: Requested JSON form
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points if the JSON is parseable but omits one or two requested fields.

criteria.description: Computes 7305 span days, 20.0 span years, 46 regional-summary days, and 0.006297 window fraction.
criteria.name: Window calculations
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point each for span days, span years, regional-summary days, and fraction.

criteria.description: Computes precipitation max/mean ratio as 2.8095 and maximum-temperature contrast as 5.2011 C.
criteria.name: Weather contrast calculations
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2 points for each correct contrast value within tolerance.

criteria.description: Uses the stated RGB pixel thresholds to report 100.0 percent pre-scene black pixels, 82.6421 percent event-scene bright pixels, and two no-sufficient-scene statuses.
criteria.name: Scene-pair checks
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for pre-scene black percent, 1 point for event-scene bright percent, and 2 points for the two scene-pair statuses.

criteria.description: Applies all four gates, computes KSCI as 10, and returns long_window_retreat_consistency_pass.
criteria.name: Index gates and label
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for gates, 1 point for KSCI, and 1 point for the label.

criteria.description: Keeps the consequence short and tied to the computed gates.
criteria.name: Computed consequence
criteria.partial_credit: Award 0.5 points for a consequence that is directionally correct but too verbose.

criteria.description: Does not convert single-scene brightness or mapped counts into measured area or affected-population totals.
criteria.name: No extra inference
